description: Na₂NiAlF₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to eight F atoms to form distorted NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with six NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NiF₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent AlF₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.41 Å) and four longer (2.71 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to eight F atoms to form NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent AlF₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent AlF₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 50°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.66 Å. Ni is bonded to six F atoms to form NiF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiF₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent AlF₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-55°. There are two shorter (1.97 Å) and four longer (1.98 Å) Ni-F bond lengths. Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent NiF₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 39°. There are four shorter (1.80 Å) and two longer (1.83 Å) Al-F bond lengths. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ni, and one Al atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ni atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Al atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Al tetrahedra.
